SELECT ((SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' LIMIT 1) - (SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' LIMIT 1)) * 100.0 / (SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' LIMIT 1) AS pct
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE substr(birthday,1,4) = '1970' AND substr(birthday,6,2) = '10'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 1 AND l.status IN ('C','D');
SELECT DISTINCT a.frequency AS how_often, t.k_symbol AS aim FROM account a JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id = 3 AND t.amount = 3539;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district WHERE A11 > 6000 AND A11 < 10000;

SELECT t3.account_id FROM client t1 JOIN disp t2 ON t1.client_id = t2.client_id JOIN account t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id JOIN district t4 ON t1.district_id = t4.district_id WHERE t1.gender = 'F' ORDER BY t1.birth_date ASC, t4.A11 ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT d.A2 FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' GROUP BY d.A2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 9;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT races.name FROM results JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND results.rank > 0 ORDER BY results.rank ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT drivers.forename, drivers.surname FROM drivers JOIN lapTimes ON drivers.driverId = lapTimes.driverId WHERE lapTimes.time = (SELECT MIN(time) FROM lapTimes);

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN circuits.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM races JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId WHERE races.name = 'European Grand Prix';
SELECT drivers.forename, drivers.surname, driverStandings.points FROM driverStandings JOIN drivers ON driverStandings.driverId = drivers.driverId ORDER BY driverStandings.points DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT circuits.lat, circuits.lng FROM circuits JOIN races ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId WHERE races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT drivers.forename, drivers.surname, (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', drivers.dob)) AS age FROM drivers WHERE drivers.nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY drivers.dob DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT drivers.forename, drivers.surname FROM results JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId WHERE results.raceId = 872 AND results.time IS NOT NULL AND results.time <> '' ORDER BY drivers.dob DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT races.name, results.points FROM results JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY races.date ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT drivers.forename, drivers.surname FROM pitStops JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId WHERE drivers.nationality = 'German' AND STRFTIME('%Y', drivers.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985' GROUP BY drivers.driverId ORDER BY AVG(pitStops.duration) ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN results.time IS NOT NULL AND results.time <> '' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(results.driverId) FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.date = '1983-07-16';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE raceId > 50 AND raceId < 100 AND statusId = 2 AND time IS NOT NULL AND time <> '';
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL AND dob <> '' ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT circuits.lat, circuits.lng FROM circuits JOIN races ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId WHERE races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix';
SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'
SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget
SELECT b.category FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location = 'MU 215' AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker' AND b.spent = 0
SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

SELECT b.category, SUM(ex.cost) FROM expense ex JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND ex.approved = 'true' GROUP BY b.category
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE mj.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'
SELECT b.category, SUM(b.amount) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY SUM(b.amount) ASC
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.amount FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'
SELECT mj.major_name FROM major mj JOIN member m ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Angela' AND m.last_name = 'Sanders'
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Death Touch';
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute at ON ha.attribute_id = at.id WHERE at.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT at.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute at ON ha.attribute_id = at.id WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id LEFT JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat';
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY s.superhero_name;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Stealth';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female';
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND [ANA Pattern] = 'S' AND [aCL IgM] > (SELECT AVG([aCL IgM]) * 1.2 FROM Examination)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE l.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND e.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1 AND strftime('%Y', e.[Examination Date]) = '1997' AND p.SEX = 'F'
SELECT e.[aCL IgM] FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND p.Description = '1994-02-19' AND e.[Examination Date] = '1993-11-12'
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Admission = '-' AND l.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND l.[T-BIL] < 2.0

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GLU >= 180 AND l.[T-CHO] < 250
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND GPT > 30 AND ALB < 4 ORDER BY ID
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=');
SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM connected WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) FROM connected WHERE atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR atom_id2 = 'TR009_12';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom_id) FROM atom WHERE element IN ('i','s') AND molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-');
SELECT a.element, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060';
SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';
SELECT a.element FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC LIMIT 1;
